email.body1:
Danielle, saw IMPLAN launched the Forward Linkages Suite for downstream tariff and price-shift analysis.

A first-of-its-kind release usually opens more consulting, government, and enterprise accounts than the regional team can work before the launch buzz fades, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for IMPLAN off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Danielle, quick follow-up for IMPLAN.

A new product line usually raises the regional pipeline target faster than headcount can follow. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Danielle, last bit of proof for IMPLAN.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how IMPLAN's reply rate likely compares to other analytics and data software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
